record.question: In Ms Word, Shimmer, Sparkle text, Blinking background etc. are known as:
record.explanation: Shimmer, sparkle and blinking-background animations are legacy Word animated Text Effects. Microsoft’s Office specification explicitly categorizes these named animations as text effects. This differs from the static font-dialog effects tested in Q21. These legacy animations may be unsupported or deprecated in modern Word; this solution identifies the historical feature terminology rather than promising a current ribbon command. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_standards/ms-oi29500/be63571b-d120-4e6c-8793-5326f06cba49
